## FilesystemKeyProvider class

Key provider that stores private keys on the filesystem.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class FilesystemKeyProvider implements KeyProvider 
```
**Implements:** [KeyProvider](./core.keyprovider.md)

## Remarks

This is the default key provider. Private keys are stored at: - macOS/Linux: \~/.config/attest-it/private.pem - Windows: %APPDATA%<!-- -->\\<!-- -->attest-it<!-- -->\\<!-- -->private.pem
